{{Quote|[The Hemes Arbora] originally came from here, Carrivar, and migrated to Osseriton here, via Umaren'k.|[[Saba Sebatyne]]|<ref name="Refugee" />}}
'''Osseriton''' was the only planet in the [[Osseriton system/Legends|Osseriton system]] of the [[Unknown Regions/Legends|Unknown Regions]]. The [[Hemes Arbora]] settled there after abandoning their [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]] of [[Carrivar]].<ref name="Refugee" />

[[Chiss Expansionary Defense Force]] teams queried the world and its inhabitants and recorded the data in their [[Expeditionary Library|library]].
